## Saywell 0.1.4

- 免费 AI 使用统一的 `free-model` 配置。启用服务时会说明文本的处理方，主模型故障时可自动切换备用服务。
- 跟写练习支持将本次输入应用到编辑框。改进 X 编辑器对带链接、话题和表情的文本的识别。

## Changes in 0.1.4

- Saywell Free AI uses the stable `free-model` preset. Setup discloses the processors used for automatic fallback.
- Apply your practice attempt directly to the editor. Text replacement on X supports additional link, hashtag and emoji decorations.
